notes: S4 (decision 2026-11-18 #4, decided by principle), S4/H1 (§4.4, §5.3): a record target that declares a fresh key as human, self-signed and cosigned by org-1 (a trusted organization key of the keyset); no human key of the keyset signs it. The declaration is valid. The record being verified is part of the verification context, so its own key is declared human (its governing class) and the valid self-signature is a valid signature by a key declared human: N_NO_HUMAN_SIGNATURE is not reported. The Python verifier did not register a record target in its own context and reported the notice.
